images.title: Mean in three steps
images.purpose: Give a compact recap of the method: add the values, divide by how many there are, read the mean.
images.composition: One horizontal chain of three steps across the middle of the frame, joined by arrows, with the rule as one short line below.
exact_structure: Step 1 on the left: exactly 3 amber (#E69F00) square tiles reading 5, 9 and 7.
An arrow to step 2: a teal (#0072B2) box reading Sum 21.
An arrow labelled ÷ 3 to step 3: a reddish purple (#CC79A7) circle reading Mean 7.
One line of text centred under the chain: Mean = Sum ÷ Number of values.
Arithmetic check for the reviewer only, NOT drawn in the frame: 5 + 9 + 7 = 21 and 21 ÷ 3 = 7.
rejection: a sum other than 21 or a mean other than 7
the arrows in the wrong order
images.takeaway: To find the mean, add all the values and divide by the number of values.
images.description: Three tiles 5, 9 and 7 lead by arrows to Sum 21, then ÷ 3, then a purple circle Mean 7, with the rule written below.
images.context: Shown beside the concept text and video for this concept.
images.teaching_notes: Use it as the checklist while comparing groups in the practice.

image_decisions.why: A three step chain recaps the mean method for the practice.
